note: Scenarios drive a reference PagedPool directly. `state` after each op holds every bookkeeping field. Ties in `mass` among positive entries are avoided on purpose (torch.argsort(descending) is unstable on ties).

scenarios.name: first_admission_and_lru_eviction
scenarios.description: Empty card filled by the first admission (slots in mass-descending order), then single-expert admissions that evict the occupant with the smallest last_seen (empty slots first; ties -> lowest slot index). No exploration.

scenarios.name: empty_card_one_at_a_time
scenarios.description: Fresh pool, one expert per text: shows empty slots are used first (in slot order), last_seen/ever/admits bookkeeping and that re-admitting a resident expert costs no load.

scenarios.name: later_pass_fills_room
scenarios.description: A sparse first pass leaves room; a later pass of the SAME forward admits more using only ITS OWN mass (the vote only includes each forward's first pass). A third pass on a full card does nothing. Then a new forward of the same text: its vote is first-pass-1 + first-pass-2.

scenarios.name: text_vote_accumulation
scenarios.description: Several forwards of one text: each forward is admitted by the accumulated vote of all first passes so far, not by its own mass. Forward 2 prefers e4..e7 but the vote still favours e0..e3 (no load); forward 3 tips the vote and swaps all four. A new text (begin_text) clears the vote.

scenarios.name: exploration_config_values
scenarios.description: explore_bias 0.65, explore_steps 1000 (config.yaml). bias = 0.65*exp(-recent/fair), fair = resident/n = 0.5, computed from `recent` BEFORE it decays by (1-1/1000). admit(mass, merit): the card follows `mass` (router + bonus), the prune clock (last_seen) follows `merit` (router alone). recent += 1/explore_steps for every expert added to the forward's admitted set (resident or not). explore=False leaves recent and bias alone; explore_bias 0 disables exploration even when explore=True.

scenarios.name: exploration_fast_decay
scenarios.description: explore_bias 0.65 with explore_steps 8 so `recent` moves visibly: +0.125 per admission to the forward's admitted set, x0.875 per exploring forward.

dying_cases.name: typical
dying_cases.note: per_step 0.5, window 50; e4/e5 are inside their trial -> 0

dying_cases.name: born_in_future_is_young
dying_cases.note: now - born < trial -> young -> 0 even for negative age

dying_cases.name: newborn_clamped_to_own_age
dying_cases.note: last_seen 0 for experts born at 900..: idle capped by age*per_step
